overall_validity.rationale: Core variables and rules are instantiated faithfully: low interaction priority is reflected in consistently task-focused behavior with only light politeness; moderate queue pressure appears as steady-flow context and gentle handle-time reminders; sparse knowledge is shown via limited, generic returns guidance with a small, policy-consistent snippet surfacing once; customer sociability is neutral and cooperative; and the consequence structure is explicitly tracked in narrative form, matching the described risk–return trade-offs. Authority, constraints, and multi-channel capabilities are respected, with appropriate use of customer chat, internal processing via the Back-office Specialist, and an email label, plus planned follow-up tracking. The only notable deviation is that the agent does not actually exercise the “service plus insight” goal to collect feedback or additional insight, keeping questions purely instrumental to resolution; this under-uses one objective-dimension variable but does not introduce contradictions or new causal factors, nor does it distort other variables or rules. Rendering instructions are followed closely, with fully populated round structure, no extraneous confounds, and coherent temporal and contextual evolution. Because the single shortcoming concerns the degree to which one objective (feedback/insight) is behaviorally expressed rather than a structural mismatch of the environment or rules, its influence on the interpretability of the simulation is minor, supporting an overall rating of highly_valid.
